leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Wire a reactive text input to an Observable using fromEvent or a FormControl valueChanges stream
Apply debounceTime and distinctUntilChanged to throttle API calls without losing keystrokes
Use switchMap to cancel in-flight HTTP requests when a new search term arrives
Handle errors inside the inner observable so the outer stream stays alive across network failures
Render asynchronous results and loading state using the async pipe with no manual subscribe/unsubscribe
Apply ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush to ensure the component only re-renders when results arrive
Write a unit test that verifies debounce behaviour using RxJS marble testing with TestScheduler
